searchText: Does anyone know how was the tx replacement logic adapted for EIP-1559? Before London Geth would let you "resend" a tx if the new gasPrice was >= 110% the previous one. I'm trying to find the London version of this. self-answer: it's here https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/core/tx_list.go#L279
